newsitem.title: FRANCE: St-Gobain has no Essilor comment.
newsitem.headline: St-Gobain has no Essilor comment.

text.p: A spokesman for Saint-Gobain said he had no comment on a market rumour the company might be planning a buy-out offer on contact lenses company Essilor.
"We have no comment on market rumours," the spokesman said.
Essilor was suspended on the Paris Bourse today pending a statement after a board meeting, expected shortly after market closing at 1600 GMT.
Saint-Gobain has a 20.10 percent stake in Essilor. Valoptec, a firm with a 17.40 percent stake in Essilor, is for 25.23 percent owned by Saint-Gobain.
Essilor staff has 3.20 percent and the rest is quoted.
